scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Creamys?
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
你獵殺夠50只克瑞米了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Remember, I need help hunting Creamys so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺克瑞米，去殺夠50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

請獵殺50只克瑞米。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

[Laertes]
I work for an apothecary in Prontera.
I come here to collect materials for medicine.
scripts.translation:

我在普隆德拉的一家藥店幹活，來這裡收集製藥材料。

Here you go, as promised.
